description: The function-graph formula holds under full semantics exactly when, for each input \(x\), the assigned binary relation has a unique output \(y\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize_functionGraphFormula.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] (F : ℕ) (a : ℕ → M)
  (r : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationAssignment M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize a r
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.functionGraphFormula F) ↔
    ∀ (x : M), ∃! y, r 2 F ![x, y]
